milestone: M63 Runtime Product Gap Closure Evidence

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Commits every consumed selected Product DoD gap closure evidence item into the product evidence matrix so a headless caller can prove product completion after multiple remaining gaps close.
Keeps closure admission owned by the existing Rust runtime selected-gap closure authorization path and only consumes closure evidence that matches current policy gap fingerprints.

Persists a bounded matrix payload containing deterministic closure-set evidence and a closure-set fingerprint without raw policy, prompt, provider, file, output, command, environment, path, or secret content.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with runtime_permission_enforcement and progress_visualization support.
answers.new_capability: Product evidence matrix derivation can consume and commit a deterministic set of multiple selected Product DoD gap closures, not only one compatibility closure.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M63.1 consumed closure evidence while scanning gaps, but the matrix result and fingerprint exposed at most one selected_gap_closure_evidence item, so multi-gap completion could be admitted without a bounded proof of every closure consumed.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Brownie would remain unable to replayably prove that all policy-declared open required gaps were closed before a product_complete decision when more than one closure contributed.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M63.1 closure recording and single-gap matrix consumption: this phase changes matrix commitment semantics for multiple consumed closures.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The existing headless.run.drive product_evidence_derivation result shape is extended; no JSON-RPC method is added.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The change adds structured closure-set evidence and a fingerprint to existing runtime evidence, not a report, digest, history, readiness, inspection, preview, verdict, or summary wrapper.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Runtime now returns and persists selected_gap_closure_evidence_set plus selected_gap_closure_set_fingerprint, includes them in the matrix fingerprint, completes only when all open required gaps are either closed by matching evidence or absent, and still selects the next unclosed gap when any required gap remains open.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A headless caller can deterministically decide whether to stop or continue after multi-gap closure by inspecting one bounded matrix rather than reconstructing hidden consumed closure state.
answers.milestone_progress: Closes the M63 residual under-commitment gap for selected Product DoD gap closure evidence and moves the milestone closer to closeout.

reject_when: matrix fingerprint omits consumed closure-set evidence
multiple closed required gaps collapse to one unprovable closure
missing behavior test for partial and complete multi-gap closure selection
automatic provider, tool, shell, git, network, service, or workspace mutation

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: Manifest updates select the current M63.2 value gate; no guard engine logic is changed.

exit_criteria: Product evidence matrix results expose a bounded selected_gap_closure_evidence_set and selected_gap_closure_set_fingerprint when closure evidence is consumed
Product evidence matrix fingerprint commits the complete consumed closure set
A policy with two open required gaps and two matching closure evidence items produces no selected remaining gap and an effective product completion claim
A policy with one matching closure and one still-open required gap still selects the remaining gap and does not claim product completion
Existing single-gap selected_gap_closure_evidence compatibility remains valid
VSIX protocol accepts the bounded closure-set fields and rejects malformed closure-set evidence or fingerprints
No new JSON-RPC method, report, readiness, inspection, digest, history, shell/git/network/service action, provider/tool execution, or workspace mutation is added
behavior_evidence: Rust behavior test project_completion_policy_commits_all_closed_required_gap_evidence covers full and partial multi-gap closure selection and closure-set fingerprint production.

Rust behavior test headless_run_drive_selects_remaining_product_dod_gap_and_decides confirms the existing end-to-end closure matrix now carries a closure-set payload and fingerprint while preserving single-gap compatibility.

VSIX runtimeClient protocol tests accept bounded selected_gap_closure_evidence_set and selected_gap_closure_set_fingerprint fields and reject malformed nested closure evidence and invalid fingerprints.

accepted_capability: Product evidence matrix derivation can prove all consumed selected Product DoD gap closures as one deterministic set.
Partial multi-gap closure keeps the next unclosed required gap selected.
Complete multi-gap closure can support a product_complete decision with replayable closure-set evidence.
behavior_evidence: Focused Rust tests cover multi-gap closure set commitment and the existing end-to-end closure matrix path.
VSIX validator tests cover the bounded transport shape without moving policy authority into the extension.
safety_boundary: Consumes only closure evidence previously accepted by the Rust runtime selected-gap closure path.
Requires exact selected remaining gap fingerprint and policy gap equality before treating a gap as closed.
Does not expose raw policy, evidence artifact, prompt, provider, stdout, stderr, command, environment, path, or secret content.
Does not run providers, tools, shell, git, network, services, or workspace mutation.
non_goals: Does not add a new JSON-RPC method or wrapper surface.
Does not create, delete, or mutate workspace files.
Does not change selected-gap closure authorization semantics.
Does not auto-close gaps without explicit closure evidence.
rejected_alternatives: Rejected a closure-set report because product completion decisions need matrix-bound runtime evidence.
Rejected relying on only the legacy selected_gap_closure_evidence field because it under-commits multi-gap completion.
Rejected caller-authored closed statuses because they bypass runtime-owned closure evidence.
technical_debt: Runtime product-loop logic remains concentrated in crates/brownie-runtime/src/lib.rs.
Closure-set commitment uses exact selected gap fingerprints; broader Product DoD semantic equivalence remains out of scope.
next_capability_rationale: After merge, M63 should be evaluated for closeout rather than extended with another wrapper-like evidence surface.
